_what: Brief 5 T4 step 2 (shadow/cull cvar ladder, Ryan option 2): do runtime cvar levers recover forest_floor headroom? Measured at forest_floor vs the as-is baseline, world at pre-density-daylight (185k trees).

baseline.min_det_note: 3-run A/A; the v3 reference 0.016 did NOT hold on this build (~4.6x higher). All verdicts use 0.0737.

A_r.Shadow.RadiusThreshold.why: ShadowDepths never moved (<1x floor); forest_floor trees have large screen radius, so a 0.03-0.10 threshold culls none. A threshold high enough to cull them is a visible-shadow loss.

B_r.Shadow.DistanceScale.why: Only the 0.25 rung pays (0.75/0.5 negligible). Quarter shadow distance = large visible-shadow trade for 0.128 ms.

D_r.Lumen.Reflections.MaxRoughnessToTrac.why: LumenReflections moved -0.22..-0.26 (3x floor) but the frame-p90 gain is only 0.05 ms (<0.10) -- the reflection saving does not surface at p90.

E_r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge.why: NaniteVisBuffer never dropped >=3x floor (worse at 8). Nanite raster here is not tri-edge-bound at these distances.

F_foliage.CullDistanceScale.why: Cvar requires per-type opt-in; all live FoliageTypes have enable_cull_distance_scaling=false (density_baseline.json:1115+). Enabling it is a FoliageType asset write, out of this step's fence. Foliage.MinimumScreenSize is not a 5.8 cvar (absent from the Foliage module).

stack.vs_rule_1.0: 0.128 << 1.0 -> per Ryan's rule, run arm F (inert, skipped) and report; NOT ASK #3 (no visual trade worth presenting for 0.128 ms).

conclusion: The runtime cvar levers do NOT recover meaningful forest_floor headroom. Best case arm B = 0.128 ms (1.7x floor) with a heavy shadow-distance visual trade, against the ~2.7 ms deficit the density upgrade needs. The forest_floor GPU cost (~12.6 ms at m=1) is structural: ShadowDepths, NaniteVisBuffer and LumenReflections are each ~1-2 ms and none is cheaply reducible by a runtime cvar without a visual trade or an asset opt-in. Neither T4 rungs (step 1: bounded, mostly untouchable) nor cvar levers (step 2: <=0.13 ms) unlock the density upgrade at forest_floor.
options_for_ryan: Accept the shipped m=1 forest at forest_floor; pursue density only where there is headroom (plaza recalibrated cap 2.157, treeline/vista under budget).
Raise the forest_floor GPU budget (currently 13.0) -- a budget re-rule, not a lever.
An asset-write path (FoliageType cull opt-in, or per-type shadow flags) -- a new tier with the persist protocol, beyond this cvar-only step.
Accept a visible trade: arm B shadow distance 0.25 (0.128 ms) or arm E/D at higher settings with stills -- small gains, real visual cost.
